name: DIAC
summary: A DIAC is a bidirectional triggering semiconductor device used in a documented control circuit.
description: A DIAC is a bidirectional triggering semiconductor device used in a documented control circuit. Its terminals and breakover characteristics are defined by the selected component.
readingNotes: Follow the trigger circuit rather than treating the device as a controlled switch with a separate gate.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A DIAC does not have the same controlled gate terminal as a TRIAC.
